description: Compare Mentalyc and Upheal AI scribes for therapists. See differences in session analytics, pricing models, note templates, and which is best for your therapy practice.

summary.bottom_line: Both Mentalyc and Upheal are therapy-specific AI scribes, but they emphasize different capabilities. Mentalyc focuses on deep therapy note customization with Alliance Genie relationship tracking. Upheal offers unique session analytics (talk-time, sentiment) plus built-in telehealth and flexible pay-per-session pricing. Choose Mentalyc for extensive therapy templates and therapeutic relationship insights. Choose Upheal for session analytics and pay-per-session economics.

sections.heading: Mentalyc vs Upheal: Overview
sections.content: Mentalyc and Upheal are both AI scribes built specifically for mental health professionals—unlike general-purpose tools like Freed. The key difference is their analytical focus: Mentalyc's Alliance Genie tracks therapeutic relationship quality, while Upheal provides session-level analytics like talk-time ratios, sentiment tracking, and silence detection. Both generate therapy notes in seconds and integrate with popular EHRs like SimplePractice and TherapyNotes.

sections.heading: Analytics Approaches: Alliance Genie vs Session Analytics
sections.content: Mentalyc's Alliance Genie focuses on therapeutic alliance—the quality of the relationship between therapist and client. It surfaces insights about engagement and connection. Upheal takes a different approach with objective session metrics: how much each party speaks (talking ratio), emotional sentiment across the session timeline, silence patterns, and topic frequency. If you want to understand the therapeutic relationship, choose Mentalyc. If you want to objectively measure session dynamics, choose Upheal.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Mentalyc uses flat monthly subscription pricing (contact for exact rates, typically in the $70-100/month range). Upheal offers more flexibility: a free tier (typed notes only), $19/month or $1/session (50 notes), and $69/month or $1/session capped (100 notes). For low-volume practitioners who see fewer sessions, Upheal's pay-per-session model can be significantly more affordable. For high-volume therapists, monthly subscriptions from either may be similar.

sections.heading: Telehealth Integration
sections.content: Upheal includes built-in HIPAA-compliant video for telehealth sessions with integrated AI recording. Mentalyc does not have built-in video—it works with external telehealth platforms via upload or integration. For telehealth-first practices wanting a single platform, Upheal is simpler. If you already have a telehealth solution, both work via integration.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Both are excellent therapy-specific AI scribes. Your choice depends on what kind of insights you value:

recommendations.when: You want extensive therapy note templates, you value Alliance Genie therapeutic relationship insights, you prefer flat monthly pricing, or you need the deepest therapy-specific customization

You want objective session analytics (talk-time, sentiment), you prefer pay-per-session pricing, you want built-in telehealth video, you see fewer sessions per month, or you value Golden Thread progress tracking
You're a psychiatrist doing medication management—neither Mentalyc nor Upheal is optimized for brief med check visits

faqs.q: Is Mentalyc or Upheal better for therapists?
faqs.a: Both are excellent therapy-specific tools. Mentalyc offers deeper template customization and Alliance Genie relationship tracking. Upheal offers unique session analytics (talk-time, sentiment) and built-in telehealth. Choose based on whether you value relationship insights (Mentalyc) or session dynamics analytics (Upheal).

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: Mentalyc or Upheal?
faqs.a: Upheal offers more flexible pricing including a free tier and $1/session option capped at $69/month. Mentalyc uses flat monthly subscriptions. For low-volume practitioners, Upheal is often cheaper. For high-volume therapists, both land in similar price ranges.

faqs.q: Does Upheal or Mentalyc have built-in telehealth?
faqs.a: Only Upheal has built-in HIPAA-compliant video for telehealth sessions. Mentalyc integrates with external telehealth platforms but doesn't include its own video. If you want one platform for video + AI notes, choose Upheal.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Alliance Genie and Golden Thread?
faqs.a: Alliance Genie (Mentalyc) tracks therapeutic relationship quality and engagement. Golden Thread (Upheal) tracks client progress session-to-session and generates insurance-compliant treatment plans. Both aim to surface longitudinal insights, but with different focuses.
